title: InferCept: Efficient Intercept Support for Augmented Large Language Model Inference
authors: Reyna Abhyankar; Zijian He; Vikranth Srivatsa; Hao Zhang; Yiying Zhang

problem_statement.en: Existing LLM inference systems treat external tool interceptions as request terminations, leading to unnecessary recomputation of KV caches and inefficient GPU memory usage. This recomputation accounts for 37-40% of total model forwarding time.
problem_statement.zh: 現有 LLM 推理系統將外部 tool 呼叫視為請求終止，導致 KV cache 被迫重新計算，造成 GPU 記憶體的浪費。此類重新計算佔整體模型前向傳遞時間的 37–40%。

key_innovation.en: INFERCEPT, a min-waste interception framework that dynamically chooses between preserving, swapping, or chunked recomputation of KV caches to minimize GPU memory waste during external tool interceptions.
key_innovation.zh: INFERCEPT 是一個以最小化浪費為目標的 interception 框架，能在外部 tool 呼叫期間動態選擇保留、swap 或分塊重計算 KV cache，從而將 GPU 記憶體浪費降至最低。

key_improvements.en: 1.6x-2x higher serving throughput, 2x more completed requests per second, 1.3x-12x lower normalized latency.
key_improvements.zh: serving throughput 提升 1.6x–2x，每秒完成請求數提升 2x，normalized latency 降低 1.3x–12x。

ai_task: LLM Serving, Augmented LLM Inference, Tool-augmented LLM, Multi-step Chatbot, Image Generation, Text-to-Speech
traffic_pattern: Iteration-level scheduling, Request interception, KV cache transfer
offload_trigger: Tool/API-call interception: at each interception the framework decides per sequence whether to keep KV in GPU memory, swap it to CPU, or discard it and later recompute.
prefetch_signal_timing: Reactive on interception return: swap-in starts strictly after the tool call returns; swap-out volume is bounded per iteration by a load-adaptive budget so transfers overlap the current forward pass.
costs_modeled: PCIe bandwidth, GPU FLOPs recompute, transfer-vs-recompute crossover
agent_awareness: Tool-call interceptions in augmented-LLM serving: the min-waste decision fires at each interception; no per-tool duration prediction and no multi-agent sharing.

when_to_offload_rule.en: At every interception, choose the action (keep in HBM, swap to CPU, or discard-and-recompute) that minimizes expected wasted GPU memory-time given swap and recompute costs, with per-iteration swap volume bounded by a load-adaptive budget.
when_to_offload_rule.zh: 於每次 interception 時，在 keep（保留於 HBM）、swap（換出至 CPU）與 discard（丟棄後重算）之間，選擇使預期浪費之 GPU 記憶體×時間最小的動作；每次迭代的 swap 量受負載自適應預算限制。
